page.layout: One printed page, one text column. Running head at top centre. No marginal notes in the text block. Gathering signature "d.ii." at the foot right of the column. The dark strip at the left edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: non edi panem,& bibi vinum?Quod si negare voles, Paulus te redarguet, sic scribens, Quotiescunque comederitis panem hunc,& hoc poculum biberitis,mortem Domini annunciate. Cui omnino respondet quod dixit Dominus, Facite hoc in mei memoriam.

Alius quispiam sic discerpit & lacerat verius quam secat institutionis verba, ut, Hoc est corpus meum, in signo & substantia sacramenti ponat, quod pro vobis traditur. Item, Facite hoc in meâ commemorationem, pro fine & re signi-ficata. Quanto rectius istis omnibus Irenaeus & Augustinus dicunt, Eucha-ristiam duplici rerum genere consta-re, quarum alterum sit terrenum, visi-bilia scilicet elementa, alterum coe-leste, invisibilis (inquâ) gratia corpo-ris & sanguinis Christi? Qua propor-tione, verba institutionis coenae Do-minicae rectissimè sic distribuuntur, ut prius mandatum Christi de edēdo & bibendo, res terrenas & visibiles concernat, panē dico & vinum, quae,

page.notes: Running head copied without the page number. Page number printed in a long-s style numeral, read as 51 [?]. The word "meâ" has an uncertain mark over the a [?]. "edēdo" and "panē" are read with a tilde over the e; the mark is faint. The line-end hyphens "signi-", "Eucha-", "consta-", "visi-", "coe-", "corpo-", "propor-", "Do-" are printed and kept. The left strip is show-through or the edge of the neighbouring page and is left out.
